about: Paper 1's references. status: read (the source itself was read), index (bibliographic details confirmed from a publisher's or index's record, Crossref unless 'source' says otherwise; the text not read), cited (seen only as a citation in another work), memory (not yet looked up). The text cites by pandoc key ([@key]); build.mjs makes CSL JSON from Crossref's record of each DOI (data/crossref.json, refs-crossref.mjs) and refs.json, with `csl` overriding, and page.mjs marks anything not read or index as unchecked; selftest 67 checks this file's shape. The working notes behind each entry are in atom/LITERATURE.md. Proposed merge from the 2026-11-08 literature audit. Added/updated entries have verification and flag_notes; untouched entries retain their previous verification status and were not re-audited.
